answer: Each agent identity is seeded by a payment streak: a worker must send real transfers of an increasing amount before the network counts it as a distinct earner, and that public trace is the signal separating a real operator from a farm. To fake a plume of fresh wallets, an attacker must fund every one and pay the full streak cost per identity, so the bill scales linearly with the number of seats; no single jade token of work can be multiplied across them. At thousands of fake identities the streak cost exceeds any reward the cluster can draw.
